A small skua flying east close to the sea wall. Grey upperparts, lacking any warm, rufous or brown tones, with the white on the upperwing confined to the inner webs of the outer two primaries. Relatively long, projecting central tail feathers. I didn't get a good look at the underparts but another birder had just before I noticed the bird and he said they were pale, grey. It had a light, bouncy flight with long, slender wings with the outer "hand" being markedly long.
